subject: Biology

stem: Which observation results mainly from adhesion of water?

options.html: Water rises along cellulose walls in narrow xylem vessels
Water forms droplets with minimal surface area

solution: Adhesion attracts water molecules to other polar surfaces.

stem: Why can oestradiol cross the plasma membrane without a channel?
solution: Steroid hormones diffuse through the hydrophobic bilayer.

stem: Which statement about an essential amino acid in humans is correct?

options.html: It is used only to make enzymes
It must be obtained in the diet because synthesis is insufficient

solution: Essential refers to dietary requirement, not structural uniqueness.

stem: What are the main waste products of aerobic respiration and lactate fermentation in humans?
solution: Aerobic respiration yields CO2 and water, while anaerobic muscle metabolism yields lactate.

stem: Photosynthetic rate rises from 15 to 30 degrees C but falls sharply at 45 degrees C. What best explains the fall?
solution: High temperature can denature enzymes and disrupt membranes.

stem: What is a consequence of degeneracy of the genetic code?

options.html: Each codon codes for several amino acids
Some base substitutions do not change the amino acid
Every amino acid has one codon

solution: Several codons can specify the same amino acid.

stem: During DNA replication, what do helicase and DNA polymerase do?

options.html: Helicase forms hydrogen bonds; polymerase breaks phosphodiester bonds
Helicase breaks hydrogen bonds; polymerase forms phosphodiester bonds

solution: Helicase separates strands; polymerase covalently joins nucleotides.

stem: Why do mature mammalian red blood cells and phloem sieve-tube elements have reduced organelle content?

options.html: They need more space for mitosis
More internal space is available for transport

solution: Reduced internal machinery lowers resistance/increases capacity for transported material.

stem: Which property allows stem cells to replace several adult cell types?
solution: Stem cells retain proliferative and developmental potential.

stem: Which structure is considered a non-membrane-bound organelle?
solution: Ribosomes are cellular structures that carry out translation.

stem: Which relationship is expected between axon diameter and conduction velocity in myelinated fibres?

options.html: Velocity is independent of diameter and myelin
Larger diameter generally permits faster conduction

solution: Lower internal resistance in wider axons increases conduction speed.

stem: Which human cell division uses highly unequal cytokinesis?

options.html: Early cleavage after the two-cell stage

solution: Oogenesis retains most cytoplasm in one ovum and forms polar bodies.

stem: Under the biological species concept, which evidence most strongly supports two populations being separate species?

options.html: They do not produce fertile offspring when they interbreed

solution: Reproductive isolation defines biological species.

stem: Which blood vessel is best identified by valves and a relatively thin wall?
solution: Valves support low-pressure return of venous blood.

stem: In a root cross-section, where is xylem usually found?

options.html: Outside the endodermis in the cortex

solution: Root xylem lies within the stele.

stem: What directly stimulates antibody production during an infection?

options.html: Loss of all helper T cells
Activation and clonal expansion of antigen-specific B cells

solution: Activated B cells differentiate into antibody-secreting plasma cells.

stem: Which neuron carries the impulse from a spinal cord interneuron to a muscle?
solution: Motor neurons transmit output to effectors.

stem: Increasing atmospheric CO2 raises photosynthetic rate only up to a plateau. What explains the plateau?

options.html: All carbon dioxide leaves the leaf

solution: At high CO2, light, temperature or enzyme capacity limits the rate.

stem: Which feature generally increases genetic variation in offspring?
solution: Cross-pollination combines alleles from different individuals.

stem: Why is brown adipose tissue metabolically active during cold exposure?

options.html: Uncoupled respiration releases energy as heat

solution: Uncoupling protein allows the proton gradient to generate heat.

stem: Larvae raised at two temperatures develop different adult sizes. What does this demonstrate?
solution: The same species can show phenotypic plasticity.

stem: Which conservation priority is typical of an evolutionarily distinct and globally endangered species?

options.html: Low priority because it has few relatives
High priority because it represents unique evolutionary history
Replacement by a common related species

solution: EDGE approaches value both extinction risk and phylogenetic distinctiveness.

stem: A forest fragment loses 35% of its area. Which immediate effect is most likely?

options.html: An automatic increase in every population
More edge habitat and reduced interior habitat

solution: Fragmentation increases edge-to-area ratio and alters microclimate.

stem: How do mangrove salt glands support survival?

options.html: They increase salt entry into xylem
They actively secrete excess ions onto leaf surfaces

solution: Salt excretion helps maintain cellular osmotic balance.

stem: If phytoplankton contain 12 000 kJ and zooplankton contain 1 500 kJ, what is transfer efficiency?
solution: Efficiency = 1500 / 12000 x 100.

stem: Which process transfers carbon from decomposers to the atmosphere?
solution: Decomposers oxidize organic carbon and release CO2.

stem: What type of relationship occurs between legumes and nitrogen-fixing bacteria in root nodules?
solution: Plants receive fixed nitrogen and bacteria receive carbohydrates and habitat.

stem: In a food web, removal of a top predator is most likely to cause what?

options.html: Equal population sizes for all species
Changes at several lower trophic levels

solution: Predators can produce trophic cascades.

stem: Which process can create a positive climate feedback?

options.html: Warming thaws permafrost and releases methane
More photosynthesis permanently removes all CO2

solution: Released greenhouse gases cause additional warming.

stem: Why can fertilizer runoff cause fish deaths?

options.html: Algal growth is followed by decomposition that depletes oxygen

solution: Eutrophication can cause hypoxia when decomposers respire.
